answer_1.quote: Creating a 'human-like' dialogue system is one of the important goals of artificial intelligence. Recently, due to the rapid advancements in natural language generation (NLG) techniques, datadriven approaches have attracted lots of research interest and have achieved impressive progress in producing fluent dialogue responses.

answer_2.quote: We adopt widely used BLEU and ROUGE to measure the relevance between the generation and the ground-truth. ... To measure the diversity of generated responses, we report the ratio of distinct uni/bi-grams (Dist-1/2) in all generated responses.

answer_4.quote: Considering automatic metrics may not suitably reflect the content to be evaluated, we further performed manual evaluation following previous works. Specifically, we randomly sampled 200 testing pairs from each test set and employed three annotators with professional background knowledge to evaluate the responses. ... For each comparison, annotators decided which response is better in terms of appropriateness ... and informativeness ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators conducted pairwise comparisons between CG-nAR and baseline responses, deciding which was better for appropriateness and informativeness.
